'''Mel's''' was an establishment on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]].<ref name="Real Adventure" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the [[Youngling|young]] [[human]] [[Gender|girls]] [[Fern]] and [[KB]] sped past the crowded establishment with their [[Fern and KB's hoverbike|hoverbike]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mel's first appeared in the [[This Could Be a Real Adventure|first episode]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref> The establishment was identified through its big signage in [[Aurebesh]] seen in the episode that reads "MEL'S."<ref name="Real Adventure" /> The name of the establishment is similar to [[Wikipedia:Mel's Drive-In|Mel's Drive-In]], an American restaurant chain featured in [[George Lucas]]' [[1973]] film [[Wikipedia:American Graffiti|''American Graffiti'']].<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.ultraswank.net/film/american-graffiti-and-mels-drive-in-restaurant|text=American Graffiti and Mel's Drive-In Restaurant|author=Christopher|date=2012-09-19|work=Ultra Swank|archivedate=20240523084927}}</ref>
